**Recipes** — Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or just create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group your favorites into collections.

**Meal plans** — Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically, and carry per-meal nutrition so you can see how the week shapes up.

**Shopping lists** — Visual, interactive lists organized by store. One tap checks items off. Ask for a shopping list from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry. Send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

**Cook Mode** — Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

**Nutrition** —  See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set your own daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

**Your kitchen, personalized** — Household profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets. Every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them so you don't have to repeat yourself. Invite other family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Also tracks pantry expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, learns the brands and prices you buy, and turns grocery receipts into an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.

payload.name: Drums kit- Learn+improve w AI!
payload.description: 架子鼓 AI 教学：教练指导，练习节奏与加花
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score? Ask for one. Want a detailed breakdown? Ask for that instead. Want tips that are easy enough for a child to follow? ChatGPT can do that. Want advice that feels more like a drum teacher? It can change its style to match your goals. You control the conversation.

The app is also great for small challenges. See if you can keep a steady beat for one minute. Try playing softer or louder. Practice using only one hand. Build a simple groove and slowly make it more interesting. After each try, ChatGPT can explain what changed and suggest the next challenge. Little wins add up, and every new rhythm gives you something to learn from.

This creates a different kind of music experience inside ChatGPT. Instead of only talking about drumming, you can actually drum. Instead of getting general advice, you receive feedback tied to your own performance. Instead of stopping to move between tools, everything stays together in one place. The result is a playful way to practice, learn, experiment, and improve. Whether you have never held a pair of sticks, already play every week, or just want to tap out a fun beat for a few minutes, the app turns a conversation into an interactive practice space where every hit can become a chance to learn.

payload.name: Courtroom5
payload.description: 民事法律帮助，覆盖 50 州
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Courtroom5 serves self-represented litigants (SRLs) — people who must navigate civil court without an attorney, typically because they cannot afford one. Roughly 80% of civil litigants in the United States appear without legal representation. Without guidance, they lose cases on procedural technicalities before the merits are ever heard.

The Courtroom5 app gives ChatGPT users access to three jurisdiction-aware legal tools: a case intake assessment that evaluates a user's situation and identifies applicable civil claims; a deadline calculator that returns precise procedural deadlines and consequences by state and court level; and next-step guidance for users already in active litigation. All tools are scoped to civil matters in US state and federal courts and designed for plain-language delivery to non-lawyers.

Courtroom5 is a Techstars graduate and recipient of the ABA Woman of Legal Tech recognition. We have served over 12,000 self-represented litigants across all 50 states.

payload.name: Real Random

2. Raffles & giveaways: Draw one or many winners from participant.
3. Everyday decisions: Randomly pick meals, chores, meeting order, or any list-based choice.

payload.name: Square Yards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and explore real estate across India with Square Yards.
                                                                                                    
  Square Yards gives you conversational access to one of India's largest property databases. Search
  new construction projects, rental apartments, and resale properties across major cities, all

  developer, and project status. Dive into any project to see pricing, floor plans, amenities, and
  unit configurations.                                                                              
                  
  Search rentals: Explore rental listings filtered by city, rent range, BHK type, furnishing       
  status, and amenities. Get full details on any listing including images and pricing.

  range, unit type, and amenities. View complete property details for any listing that catches your
  eye.                                                                                              
                  
  Results appear as interactive property cards with images, pricing, and direct links to      
  Square Yards. Whether you're buying your first home, searching for a rental, or exploring
  investment opportunities, Square Yards helps you make informed property decisions through

payload.name: Lifestyle Helper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lifestyle Helper improves ChatGPT answers to everyday life questions by adding reliable, up-to-date, source-backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about cooking, travel, entertainment, education, or psychology, the app enriches responses with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally without external references.

Lifestyle Helper does not collect personal data and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based only on the user’s intentions.

payload.name: Fresha

- Find villas with a jacuzzi under AED 5 million
- Show me penthouses in Dubai over 1,600 sqft

payload.name: foodpanda

Looking to buy or sell a vehicle in Canada? With AutoTrader, you get access to the largest inventory of new and used cars nationwide — from Fords and Toyotas to motorcycles, boats, and RVs. Trusted by over 5 million Canadians, our app delivers transparent pricing, expert reviews, and smart tools to help you get the best deal.

With AutoTrader, we provide you with the tools and information you need to make an informed choice. Shop with confidence!

Largest Inventory in Canada
AutoTrader gives you access to over 300,000 new and used vehicles from private sellers and car dealerships across Canada. Whether you're searching for a used car, new SUV, RV, boat, or motorcycle, you’ll find it here – and easily shop listings from both private sellers and dealerships.

payload.name: Milanuncios
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access the leading marketplace in Spain directly through ChatGPT. This app allows users to search for second-hand goods, vehicles, real estate, and professional services within the Milanuncios ecosystem. You can filter results by category, location, and price to find the best local deals in real-time. Whether you are looking for a used car, a rental apartment, or local job openings, this integration provides direct access to up-to-date listings and essential product details.

payload.name: Tessie

payload.name: BuyWise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BuyWise is a shopping assistant for comparing physical consumer products in ChatGPT. Tell BuyWise what you are looking for, including your budget, use case, preferred features, and constraints, and it helps compare relevant products from supported merchants.
BuyWise can help users:
• Search for products that match a shopping need or budget.
• Compare prices, availability, product details, and key purchase considerations across supported merchants.
• Summarize useful review signals and product tradeoffs to support a more informed purchase decision.
• Recommend suitable options for specific scenarios, such as gifts, home office setups, travel accessories, or consumer tech purchases.
• Direct users to external merchant pages to complete purchases outside ChatGPT.
BuyWise does not process payments inside ChatGPT, does not sell digital goods, and does not replace the merchant’s checkout, return, warranty, or support policies.

payload.name: Apartment List
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Apartment List brings real apartments for rent into your ChatGPT conversation.
Describe what you’re looking for — budget, commute, pets, amenities, move-in timing — and explore available rentals with up-to-date pricing, availability, and fees.

Why it’s different:

Match, Don’t Just Search: Tell us about your life. We translate it into personalized apartment matches.

Powered by Real Rental Data: Get structured, live inventory — not generic AI responses.

The Anti-Scroll: Compare apartments side by side and ask follow-up questions without leaving chat.

Stop searching. Start finding an apartment you’ll love.

Try asking:
- “Find apartments for rent under $2,300 that allow my 50lb dog.”
- “Show me current rent and availability for this apt.”
- “Compare these rentals by price and pet policies.”

payload.name: A-Z Dog Breeds

- "@A-Z Dog Breeds, I want to get a low-energy, low-shedding, small breed of dog. Show me photos and details"

payload.name: Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check
payload.description: 合同风险审查：排查协议中的风险条款
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
"Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check" helps you review contracts and spot common red flags before signing. Get a clear, card-based overview with risk flags and concise notes on key clauses. Click any card to ask ChatGPT for a deeper explanation.

How it works:
The app contains a checklist of common issues for different contract types:
- Lease
- Employment
- Freelance
- General agreements
The app instructs ChatGPT to assess your agreement through the checklist tailored to your contract type. Results of the review are presented as clickable "Ok" / "Warning" / "High-Risk" cards.

Disclaimers:
- Use this app as an extra set of eyes - not a replacement for legal advice.
- Get a lawyer’s review for high-value, high-risk, or unfamiliar terms.
- Read the full contract and make sure you understand it before signing.

Not legal advice. The developer of "Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check" is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. No attorney-client relationship is created. Outputs are AI-generated and may be inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated. Use it for informational purposes only and consult a qualified attorney for legal advice before signing. Do not use this app for criminal law matters, immigration matters, or family law disputes.

payload.name: Unni

• Procedure knowledge: expert-written guides on procedures, side effects, recovery, and procedure comparisons.
• Community: real user experiences and doctor-answered Q&A from the Unni community.
• Events: current pricing and promotions across thousands of clinics, filterable by procedure, location, consultation language, and price.

Unni searches from information pools matched to your country and language, so you can see procedure information and events that are actually available to you.

Unni provides reference information only and is not a medical recommendation. Always consult a licensed medical professional before making procedure decisions.

Whether you’re fixing a daily driver, upgrading your ride, or tackling a DIY repair, CarParts.com helps you get the job done right, without the guesswork.

Why Choose CarParts.com?
> Guaranteed Fit – Shop by year, make, and model to ensure parts fit your vehicle
> Huge Selection – From brakes and batteries to headlights, suspension, and accessories
> Trusted Quality – Engineered parts built to meet or exceed OE standards
> Great Value – Competitive prices and frequent deals
> Fast, Reliable Shipping – Get parts delivered straight to your door
> Easy Returns – Hassle-free returns for peace of mind

Shop Smarter, Anytime, Anywhere on Carparts.com, iOS and Android Mobile App and ChatGPT conversational platforms
